title: Plasma proteomics based on machine learning predict the early risk of kidney outcomes in patients with DKD: a prospective cohort study from UK Biobank.
summary: Machine-learning survival models linked plasma proteomics with future kidney outcomes in a prospective UK Biobank diabetic-kidney-disease cohort and reported a protein signature.
ai_technology: Machine-learning survival models use plasma proteomics to estimate future kidney outcomes in diabetic kidney disease.
